Challenges

Sound familiar?

“Every sale we make, we rent from Amazon.”

Marketplace-only brands pay for every click forever and live one policy change from trouble. The dual strategy builds branded demand you own alongside marketplace sales.

“Our own store gets no traffic.”

It was probably never given a search strategy. The store SEO roadmap treats it as a real channel — categories, content and authority — not a brochure.

“Amazon ads eat the margin that SEO should carry.”

Organic rank on core terms reduces the ad spend needed to defend position on both channels — the cross-channel dashboard shows the blend.

“Launches spike, then die.”

Launch playbooks sequence reviews, external traffic and keyword targeting so new ASINs build durable rank instead of a one-week spike.

“We don’t know which keywords belong where.”

The unified keyword map splits terms by where they convert best — Amazon, Google or both — so channels stop cannibalising each other.

“Competitors own our brand terms on Google.”

Branded search is the cheapest demand you will ever defend. The program secures your brand terms on Google while marketplace listings hold theirs.

“Two agencies, two dashboards, no picture.”

One team, one strategy, one cross-channel dashboard — marketplace and store performance reported together.

“We’re scared Amazon will copy or undercut us.”

Private-label pressure is real; the hedge is brand-owned demand. Branded search volume is the asset a marketplace cannot take away.

How It Works

Stop renting all of your demand

Brands that live only on Amazon rent their customers from the marketplace — paying for every click, exposed to every policy change. Brands that win long-term pair marketplace strength with their own search presence.

This program runs both plays together: Amazon listing SEO for the shelf, and Google SEO plus content that builds your own store and brand searches — so demand grows on assets you own.

  • Dual-channel audit
  • Unified keyword map
  • Amazon listing optimisations
  • Store SEO roadmap
  • Launch playbooks

FAQs

FAQs on SEO services for Amazon brands

We only sell on Amazon today. Is this for us?

Yes — the program starts with marketplace growth and phases in your own store when you are ready.

Will Amazon sales cannibalise our store?

Managed well, the channels feed each other: marketplace for discovery, your store for margin and loyalty.

Do you help launch our own store?

Through our e-commerce development partners and Shopify/WooCommerce services, yes.

How is success measured?

Marketplace revenue, store organic revenue and branded search growth — reported together.

How do the two channels share one keyword map?

Each term is assigned by intent and conversion data: transactional marketplace terms to Amazon, research and brand terms to your store, with overlap terms deliberately coordinated.

Do you need access to both our Amazon account and our store?

Yes — Seller Central (or Vendor Central) and your store platform, so the dual audit sees the whole picture before strategy is set.
